from solution import test_distinct


def test_issue_example_four_distinct():
    """Example: test_distinct([1,5,7,9]) == True."""
    # 4 items, 4 unique, 4==4 => True
    assert test_distinct([1, 5, 7, 9]) == True


def test_issue_simple_duplicate():
    """Rule: numbers not all different are not distinct."""
    # 3 items, 2 unique, 3==2 is False => False
    assert test_distinct([1, 2, 1]) == False


def test_issue_empty_input():
    """Rule: vacuously all numbers in empty input are different."""
    # 0 items, 0 unique, 0==0 => True
    assert test_distinct([]) == True


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Rule: a single number is trivially all different."""
    # 1 item, 1 unique, 1==1 => True
    assert test_distinct([42]) == True


def test_issue_all_same():
    """Rule: numbers not all different are not distinct."""
    # 3 items, 1 unique, 3==1 is False => False
    assert test_distinct([3, 3, 3]) == False


def test_issue_duplicate_at_ends():
    """Rule: repeated first and last values are not distinct."""
    # 4 items, 3 unique, 4==3 is False => False
    assert test_distinct([1, 2, 3, 1]) == False


def test_issue_adjacent_duplicate():
    """Rule: any repeated pair means not all different."""
    # 4 items, 3 unique, 4==3 is False => False
    assert test_distinct([1, 2, 2, 3]) == False


def test_issue_negative_zero_positive():
    """Rule: all different numbers including negatives are distinct."""
    # 3 items, 3 unique, 3==3 => True
    assert test_distinct([-1, 0, 1]) == True


def test_contract_bool_on_true():
    """Contract: distinct result must be a bool."""
    # 2 items, 2 unique, 2==2 => True, type is bool => True
    assert isinstance(test_distinct([5, 6]), bool) == True


def test_contract_bool_on_false():
    """Contract: non-distinct result must be a bool."""
    # 2 items, 1 unique, 2==1 is False => False, type is bool => True
    assert isinstance(test_distinct([5, 5]), bool) == True
